多重指标与微分记号（Multi-index and Differential Notation）

准备符号

查看 Lawrence C.Evans Partial differential equations Appendix A

令多重指标(multiindex) \alpha=(\alpha_1, ... , \alpha_n), \quad \alpha_i \in\mathbb N_0\quad(i=1,\ldots,n)，

|\alpha| := \alpha_1 + ... + \alpha_n
\alpha ! := \alpha_1!\cdots\alpha_n!
\begin{pmatrix} |\alpha| \\ \alpha \end{pmatrix} := \frac{ |\alpha|!}{\alpha!}

对于多元变量 x=(x_1, ... , x_n)，

x^\alpha := x_1^{\alpha_1}\cdots x_n^{\alpha_n}
D^\alpha u(x) := \frac{\partial^{|\alpha|} u(x)}{\partial x_1^{\alpha_1}\cdots\partial x_n^{\alpha_n}} = \frac{\partial^{\alpha_1} }{\partial x_1^{\alpha_1}} \cdots \frac{\partial^{\alpha_n}}{\partial x_n^{\alpha_n}}u(x)

事实上，对于 u(x)\in C^k（这里 k\ge2），\frac{\partial^2 u(x)}{\partial x_1\partial x_2} = \frac{\partial^2 u(x)}{\partial x_2 x_1}，微分顺序可交换。 因此在定义 D^k u(x) 的时候，将不同微分次序的前导数看成是同一个。

D^k u(x) = \{ D^\alpha u(x) \mid |\alpha|=k \}

nabla算子

\nabla u = (\frac{\partial u}{\partial x_1}, ..., \frac{\partial u}{\partial x_n})

Laplace算子

\Delta u = \nabla\cdot\nabla u = \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x_1^2} + ... + \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x_n^2}

参考：教材相应章节 / Reference。
